notes.title: Release!
notes.notes:
[h1]Kari is finally fully released! [/h1]
After almost a year of development the game is out! We've worked and fixed and polished and are extremely proud to share with you the final product of our efforts.

We're incredibly grateful to have such amazing support from a dedicated community that loves Kari as much as we do. We hope you all and many more will explore Vanaheim with her and enjoy her adventure.

[h1]And now...[/h1]
Kari is a student project by a team of students from the Breda University of Applied Sciences. We've reached the end of the duration for this project and polished and fixed past that even. However now the year is over for us and Team Unmanagable is disbanding to go on internships, holidays and pursue personal projects. Thus, Kari will no longer be updated, the game as it is live now is our final product.

Thank you all for your continued support. We hope you enjoy Kari and find enjoyment in Vanaheim.

notes.title: Polish!
notes.notes:
[b]We're hard at work here in Vanaheim Headquarters to polish the game and get it ready for release![/b]

We're getting loads of feedback from our wonderful community as well as always trying to break and then fix Kari in more and more obtuse ways. We're finding and fixing bugs, making sure that the game is as polished as possible.

We're also polishing the game in other areas, such as set dressing and the quests, filing on dialogue and making Vanaheim feel as alive as possible.

[previewyoutube=R3sA-E_fBqQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you all for your continued support and feedback! We're overjoyed with the positive response we're getting and are all so glad you're enjoying Kari.

[h2]Additonal Areas[/h2]
The first area we've added takes Kari North and high up into the mountains that belong to Uller, the one who started it all. Manoeuvre your way over and around sheer cliffs, meet the forge masters of Kliftoft, and make your way through the inhospitable lands that Uller rules.

The second area takes you to a place long abandoned, but not quite forgotten. On the Ancient Battlefield of a time where Gods faced off against each other, Kari shall have to find her way around the everlasting effects of this struggle, meet the nomadic Valkans, and face several divine entities such as Mimir and the menacing Lorelei.

notes.notes:
Thanks to the overwhelming response to our Beta and all the feedback we got, we've been hard at work getting Kari ready for our early access on [b]Monday, 22.06.20[/b].

We've been implementing feedback, adding so many [i]more quests[/i] and polishing old ones, as well as [u]fixing bugs left and right[/u]. [/list]

notes.title: The Beta is live
notes.notes:
Hey hey hey everyone!

We are happy to announce that our beta keys are currently being sent out!  
If you have signed up, you should receive a key soon. If it's not in your main inbox, it might be in your spam folder.
If you didn't sign up there is nothing to worry about, you can still sign up for the beta. Just know that you won't be getting your key for a couple of days.

We are wishing everyone that got access to the game a good time and happy bug hunting if you have any questions I refer to the official Kari discord. The developers check it regularly and will try to answer your questions asap. 
If you find any bugs please go to https://bugs.cyroxx.de/ . Sign up using a google account and report them there!  

If you haven't joined the discord yet, please join and share your joy and findings with the rest of the community!

https://discord.gg/vXZpFM4

Have a wonderful day in the realm of Vanaheim and see you in the next announcement.
